name: Design Rule Diff
blurb: two rule sets compared side by side
intro: Paste two rule sets - Rules-tab or .kicad_pro JSON, KiCad .kicad_dru, or key = value lines such as an Eagle .dru - and see every rule that changed, appeared or went away, with lengths converted to mm and whether the second set is stricter.

inputs.label: Rule set A
inputs.default:
(version 1)
(rule "Min track" (constraint track_width (min 0.127mm)))
(rule "Min clearance" (constraint clearance (min 0.127mm)))
(rule "Min drill" (constraint hole_size (min 0.2mm)))
(rule "Min via" (condition "A.Type == 'Via'") (constraint via_diameter (min 0.45mm)))
(rule "Copper to edge" (constraint edge_clearance (min 0.3mm)))
inputs.placeholder: JSON, (rule ...) blocks, or key = value lines

inputs.label: Rule set B
inputs.default:
(version 1)
(rule "Track" (constraint track_width (min 6mil)))
(rule "Clearance" (constraint clearance (min 6mil)))
(rule "Drill" (constraint hole_size (min 10mil)))
(rule "Annular" (constraint annular_width (min 5mil)))
(rule "Via" (condition "A.Type == 'Via'") (constraint via_diameter (min 20mil)))
(rule "Edge" (constraint edge_clearance (min 15mil)))
inputs.placeholder: JSON, (rule ...) blocks, or key = value lines

examples.title: Two fabs' KiCad rules (mm against mil)

input.a:
(version 1)
(rule "Min track" (constraint track_width (min 0.127mm)))
(rule "Min clearance" (constraint clearance (min 0.127mm)))
(rule "Min drill" (constraint hole_size (min 0.2mm)))
(rule "Min via" (condition "A.Type == 'Via'") (constraint via_diameter (min 0.45mm)))
(rule "Copper to edge" (constraint edge_clearance (min 0.3mm)))
input.b:
(version 1)
(rule "Track" (constraint track_width (min 6mil)))
(rule "Clearance" (constraint clearance (min 6mil)))
(rule "Drill" (constraint hole_size (min 10mil)))
(rule "Annular" (constraint annular_width (min 5mil)))
(rule "Via" (condition "A.Type == 'Via'") (constraint via_diameter (min 20mil)))
(rule "Edge" (constraint edge_clearance (min 15mil)))

input.a:
# board A
min_track = 0.15mm
min_clearance: 0.15 mm
min_drill = 0.3mm
mdWireWire = 8mil 8mil 8mil
finish = HASL
input.b:
# board B
min_track = 6mil
min_clearance: 0.2 mm
min_drill = 0.3mm
mdWireWire = 6mil 8mil 8mil
finish = ENIG
min_annular = 0.13mm

usage: Paste rule set A and B as text: JSON (flattened to dotted keys, classes keyed by name), KiCad .kicad_dru (constraint.min/max keys, with the condition), or key = value lines; lengths in mm, mil, thou, in or um are converted to mm. It returns counts of changed / only-in-A / only-in-B / same rules, a table with both values, the difference and whether B is stricter, and a change list text. Use it to review a rule change or to compare a board's rules with a fab's.
